mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury; bumetanide increases renal tubular secretion of tenofovir, elevating tenofovir concentrations and nephrotoxicity risk, while loop diuretics exacerbate volume depletion and renal hypoperfusion.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and phosphate levels closely; assess renal function before initiating combination therapy; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative antiretroviral regimens or diuretics if renal function declines.
